ya10.3.2:1.1: Yo cakkhund. parijānittha, so domanassind. pajahitthāti? Āmantā.
ya10.3.2:2.1: Yo vā pana domanassind. pajahittha, so cakkhund. parijānitthāti?
ya10.3.2:3.1: Dve puggalā domanassind. pajahittha, no ca cakkhund. parijānittha; arahā domanassindriyañ ca pajahittha, cakkhundriyañ ca parijānittha.
ya10.3.2:4.1: Yo cakkhund. parijānittha, so anaññātaññassāmītind. bhāvitthāti? Āmantā.
ya10.3.2:5.1: Yo v. p. anaññātaññassāmītind. bhāvittha, so cakkhund. parijānitthāti?
ya10.3.2:6.1: Cha puggalā anaññātaññassāmītind. bhāvittha, no ca cakkhund. parijānittha; arahā anaññātaññassāmītindriyañ ca bhāvittha, cakkhundriyañ ca parijānittha.
ya10.3.2:7.1: Yo cakkhund. parijānittha, so aññind. bhāvitthāti? Āmantā.
ya10.3.2:8.1: Yo v. p. aññind. bhāvittha, so cakkhund. parijānitthāti? Āmantā.
ya10.3.2:9.1: Yo cakkhund. parijānittha. so aññātāvind. sacchikaritthāti? Āmantā.
ya10.3.2:12.1: Yo domanassind. pajahittha, so anaññātaññassāmītind. bhavitthāti? Āmantā.
ya10.3.2:13.1: Yo v. p. anaññātaññassāmītind. bhāvittha, so domanassind. pajahitthāti?
ya10.3.2:14.1: Cattāro puggalā anaññātaññassāmītind. bhāvittha, no ca domanassind. pajahittha; tayo puggalā anaññātaññassāmītindriyañ bhāvittha, domanassindriyañ ca pajahittha.
ya10.3.2:15.1: Yo domanassind. pajahittha, so aññind. bhāvitthāti?
ya10.3.2:16.1: Dve puggalā domanassind. pajahittha, no ca aññind. bhāvittha; arahā domanassindriyañ ca pajahittha, aññindriyañ ca bhāvittha.
ya10.3.2:17.1: Yo v. p. aññind. bhāvittha . . . Āmantā.
ya10.3.2:18.1: Yo domanassind. pajahittha, so aññātāvind. sacchikaritthāti?
ya10.3.2:19.1: Tayo puggalā domanassind. pajahittha, no ca aññātāvind. sacchikarittha; arahā domanassindriyañ ca pajahittha, aññātāvindriyañ ca sacchikarittha.
ya10.3.2:20.1: Y. v. p. aññātāvind. sacchikarittha . . . Āmantā.
ya10.3.2:21.1: Yo anaññātaññassāmītind. bhāvittha, so aññind. bhāvitthāti?
ya10.3.2:22.1: Cha puggalā anaññātaññassāmītind. bhāvittha, no ca aññind. bhāvittha; arahā anaññātaññassāmītindriyañ ca bhāvittha, aññindriyañ ca bhāvittha,
ya10.3.2:23.1: Yo v. p. aññind. bhāvittha . . . Āmantā.
ya10.3.2:24.1: Yo anaññātaññassāmītind. bhāvittha, so aññātāvind. sacchikaritthāti?
ya10.3.2:25.1: Cha puggalā anaññātaññassāmītind. bhāvittha, no ca aññātāvind. sacchikarittha; arahā anaññātaññassāmītindriyañ ca bhāvittha, aññātāvindriyañ ca sacchikarittha.
ya10.3.2:26.1: Yo v. p. aññātāvind. sacchikarittha. . . . Āmantā. 4.
ya10.3.2:31.1: Dve puggalā cakkhund. na parijānittha, no ca domanassind. nappajahittha; cha puggalā cakkhundriyañ ca na parijānittha, domanassindriyañ ca nappajahittha.
ya10.3.2:32.1: Yo vā pana domanassind. nappajahittha, so cakkhund. na parijānitthāti? Āmantā.
ya10.3.2:33.1: Yo cakkhund. na parijānittha, so anaññātaññassāmītind. na bhavitthāti?
ya10.3.2:34.1: Cha puggalā cakkhund. na parijānittha, no ca anaññātaññassamītind. na bhāvittha; dve puggalā cakkhundriyañ ca na parijānittha anaññātaññassāmītindriyañ ca na bhāvittha.
ya10.3.2:35.1: Yo v. p. anaññātaññassāmītind. na bhāvittha, so cakkhund. na parijānitthāti? Āmantā.
ya10.3.2:36.1: Yo cakkhund. na parijānittha, so aññind. na bhāvitthāti? Āmantā.
ya10.3.2:37.1: Yo v. p. aññind. na bhāvittha . . . Āmantā.
ya10.3.2:38.1: Yo cakkhund. na parijānittha, so aññātāvind. na sacchikaritthāti? Āmantā.
ya10.3.2:39.1: Yo v. p. aññātāvind. na sacchikarittha . . .
ya10.3.2:40.1: Yo aggaphalaṃ sacchikaroti, so aññātāvind. na sacchikarittha, no ca cakkhund. na parijānittha; aṭṭha puggalā aññātāvindriyañ ca na sacchikarittha, cakkhundriyañ ca na parijānittha.
ya10.3.2:41.1: Yo domanassind. nappajahittha, so anaññātaññassamītind. na bhavitthāti?
ya10.3.2:42.1: Cattāro puggalā domanassind. nappajahittha, no ca anaññātaññassāmītind. na bhāvittha; dve puggalā domanassindriyañ ca nappajahittha, anaññātaññassāmītindriyañ ca na bhāvittha.
ya10.3.2:43.1: Yo v. p. anaññātaññassāmītind. na bhāvittha . . . Āmantā.
ya10.3.2:44.1: Yo domanassind. nappajahittha, so aññind. na bhāvitthāti? Āmantā.
ya10.3.2:45.1: Yo v. p. aññind. na bhāvittha . . .
ya10.3.2:46.1: Dve puggalā aññind. na bhāvittha, no ca domanassind. nappajahittha; cha puggalā aññindriyañ ca . . .
ya10.3.2:47.1: Yo domanassind. nappajahittha, so aññātāvind. na sacchikaritthāti? Āmantā.
ya10.3.2:48.1: Yo v. p. aññātāvind. na sacchikarittha . . .
ya10.3.2:49.1: Tayo puggalā aññātāvind. na sacchikarittha, no ca domanassind. nappajahittha; cha puggalā aññātāvindriyañ ca na sacchikarittha, domanassindriyañ ca nappajahittha.
ya10.3.2:50.1: Yo anaññātaññassāmītind. na bhāvittha, so aññind. na bhāvitthāti? Āmantā.
ya10.3.2:51.1: Yo v. p. aññind. na bhāvittha, no anaññātaññassāmītind. na bhāvitthāti?
ya10.3.2:52.1: Cha puggalā aññind. na bhāvittha, no ca anaññātaññassāmītind. na bhāvittha; dve puggalā aññindriyañ ca na bhāvittha, anaññātaññassāmītindriyañ ca na bhāvittha.
ya10.3.2:53.1: Yo anaññātaññassāmītind. na bhāvittha, so aññātāvind. na sacchikaritthāti? Āmantā.
ya10.3.2:54.1: Yo v. p. aññātāvind. na sacchikarittha, so anaññātaññassāmītind. na bhāvitthāti?
ya10.3.2:55.1: Satta puggalā aññātāvind. na sacchikarittha, no ca anaññātaññassāmītind. na bhāvittha, dve puggalā aññātāvindriyañ ca . . .
ya10.3.2:56.1: Yo aññind. na bhāvittha, so aññātāvind. na sacchikaritthāti? Āmantā.
ya10.3.2:57.1: Yo v. p. aññātāvind. na sacchikarittha . . .
ya10.3.2:58.1: Yo aggaphalaṃ sacchikaroti, so aññātāvind. na sacchikarittha, no ca aññind. na bhāvittha; aṭṭha puggalā aññātāvindriyañ ca na sacchikarittha, aññindriyañ ca na bhāvittha. 5.
